acxii-acne-brightening-soap.heading: Why it is on the shelf
acxii-acne-brightening-soap.lead: Half the people who ask us about breakouts have a drawer of half-used serums and no cleanser worth the name. A bar with an active in it is the cheapest change to make, and the easiest one to keep up.
acxii-acne-brightening-soap.wear: Once a day to start, in the evening, not twice. A cleansing bar with an active in it is easy to overdo and dry, tight skin an hour later is the usual sign that you have. Build up to twice daily only if your skin is comfortable. Follow it with a moisturiser every time, and wear sunscreen the next morning — exfoliating acids make skin more sensitive to UV, which undoes the tone work faster than the bar can do it.
ways: Evening — as the second cleanse, after an oil has taken off sunscreen and makeup.
Body — on the back and shoulders, where breakouts are common and most people never treat them.
Travel — a bar does not count as a liquid, which is most of why it lives in a wash bag.
acxii-acne-brightening-soap.before: Start at once a day rather than twice. A korean cleansing bar with an active in it is easy to overdo, and dry, tight skin an hour later is the sign that you have. Follow with a moisturiser every time, and wear sunscreen the next morning — a salicylic acid soap makes skin more sensitive to daylight, and tone work undone by UV is wasted. If your skin is already peeling from something else, give it a week off before you start.

ahc-premier-ampoule-in-eye-cream-40ml-1-.heading: Why it is on the shelf
ahc-premier-ampoule-in-eye-cream-40ml-1-.lead: Most eye creams come in a pot the size of a thimble and run out before you know whether they work. This one is large enough to use twice a day for months, which is the only way to find out.
ahc-premier-ampoule-in-eye-cream-40ml-1-.wear: A grain of rice per eye, patted with the ring finger from the outer corner inwards. Morning and night. Do not drag, and do not go closer than the orbital bone — product migrates towards the eye on its own overnight, and starting too close is how people wake up puffy.
ways: Morning — a grain of rice per eye, patted in with the ring finger before sunscreen.
Night — the same again, as the last step, which is when most of the work happens.
All over — the tube is large enough that most people end up using it on the whole face.
ahc-premier-ampoule-in-eye-cream-40ml-1-.before: A korean eye cream is a long game. Give it eight weeks before you decide anything, and do not expect a collagen eye cream to do what a filler does — the honest claim is on the appearance of fine lines, not on the lines themselves. Pat, never drag, and stay outside the orbital bone: product migrates towards the eye on its own overnight, and starting too close is how people wake up puffy. If your eyes are sensitive, patch it on the inner wrist for a night first.

ampoule-sheet-mask.heading: Why it is on the shelf
ampoule-sheet-mask.lead: Sold one at a time, so you can work through the range and find the one that suits you rather than committing to a box of ten. Twenty minutes is the whole commitment.
ways: Routine — over a cleansed, toned face for fifteen to twenty minutes.
Afterwards — press in what is left rather than rinsing, then moisturise.
Frequency — twice a week is plenty; nightly is not better.
ampoule-sheet-mask.before: Five kinds, and they are not interchangeable: cica for skin that is reacting, hyaluronic acid for dehydration, vitamin for dullness, arbutin for tone, tea tree for breakouts. Buy for the thing you actually have rather than one of each. Leaving a korean sheet mask on until it dries works against you — once the sheet is dry it pulls moisture back out, so take it off while it is still damp.

anjo-professional-365-70g.heading: Why it is on the shelf
anjo-professional-365-70g.lead: The best sunscreen is the one you will put on tomorrow as well. This is the plain, untinted, no-argument version for anyone who has given up on the ones that sit grey on the skin.
anjo-professional-365-70g.wear: The last step of a morning routine, after moisturiser and before makeup. Two fingers' worth for the face and neck, and reapply through the day if you are outside for any length of time. It sits under a base without pilling, which is more than most high-SPF creams manage.
ways: Every morning — the last step before makeup, two fingers' length for face and neck.
Through the day — again every two or three hours if you are out in it.
On the move — the large tube is for home; decant a little if you are out all day.
anjo-professional-365-70g.before: A daily sunscreen only works at the quantity it was tested at, which is about two fingers' length for a face and neck — most people use half that and get half the protection. This is the untinted one, so there is nothing to match to your skin and nothing to blend. If you have found a korean sun cream too heavy before, this is the lighter end of the shelf. Keep it out of a hot car; heat degrades the filters faster than time does.

anjo-professional-365-sun-bb-cream-spf50.heading: Why it is on the shelf
anjo-professional-365-sun-bb-cream-spf50.lead: Two steps collapse into one, which is the difference between wearing sunscreen every day and wearing it when you remember. The tint is light enough that it is a base rather than a decision.
anjo-professional-365-sun-bb-cream-spf50.wear: The last step of a morning routine. On its own for a day with nothing on, or under a foundation when there is. Reapply through the day if you are outside — a sun bb cream is still a sunscreen, and nothing survives six hours of daylight without a second coat.
ways: Bare face — on its own, as the only thing between a cleansed face and the door.
Under a base — as the primer step, where the shea butter stops foundation breaking up.
Top-up — pressed over makeup at four o'clock rather than rubbed in.
anjo-professional-365-sun-bb-cream-spf50.before: One shade, pitched at the middle of the range and sheer enough to adjust itself on most skin. If you wear a foundation darker than medium, treat this as a base rather than as coverage. A sun bb cream is still a sunscreen: it needs reapplying, and nothing survives six hours of daylight on one coat. Shake it before the first use of the day, because the tint settles.

artisan-ribbed-knit-midi-dress.heading: Why we took this one
artisan-ribbed-knit-midi-dress.lead: We buy very few dresses that come with a second piece, because most detachable things look detachable. This vest does not — and taken off, it is a good vest in its own right, which is really two purchases for one.
artisan-ribbed-knit-midi-dress.wear: With ankle boots and bare legs in September, with tall boots and opaque tights from November. The vest on and a long coat over the top is the version that goes out in January. Take the vest off and the dress will carry a blazer. In black it is the most formal of the three; the beige is the one that photographs best and the brown is the one we reorder most.
ways: September — vest on, ankle boots, bare legs, nothing else needed.
January — vest on, opaque tights, tall boots and a long coat over the top.
Office — vest off, a blazer over the dress, a flat loafer underneath.
artisan-ribbed-knit-midi-dress.before: Sized S–M, and the knit has real give, so the span it covers is wider than the label suggests. The waist is elastic rather than seamed, which means it sits where your waist actually is. As a petite dress long sleeve shape it needs no alteration — the sleeve ends at the wrist on a shorter frame rather than past it, which is the change most knit dresses need. Buy it for the dress and treat the vest as the second purchase; plenty of people here do it the other way round.

asymmetrical-tartan-pleated-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
asymmetrical-tartan-pleated-midi-skirt.lead: A plain tartan skirt is a plain tartan skirt. The pleated panel down one side is the whole reason this one came back with us: standing still it is heritage, walking it is something else entirely.
ways: Daytime — a plain cream knit, ankle boots, and nothing else patterned anywhere.
Work — a fine black polo neck tucked in, flat loafers, a plain coat.
Evening — a black top and a heel, with the violet in the plaid picked up in a bag.
asymmetrical-tartan-pleated-midi-skirt.before: Two sizes on the waist, and there is no stretch in the waistband — take the larger of the two if you are between them. At 27.5 inches the hem sits below the knee on most people and at mid-calf if you are petite, which suits the pleated panel rather than fighting it. This is a korean fashion skirt that does the talking, so keep everything above it plain. Dry clean, or wash cold in a mesh bag and hang by the waistband so the pleats fall straight.

autumn-explorer.heading: Why we took this one
autumn-explorer.lead: A jacket that fits nobody in particular fits almost everybody, which is the quiet trick of a boxy cut. The tie cuffs mean you can make it sharper on a day when you want it sharper.
ways: City — dark denim, a seasonal knit, cuffs tied tight and sleeves pushed up.
Considered — over a midi skirt and boots, which is the better outfit of the two.
Shoulder season — over a long-sleeved tee in April, over a jumper in October.
autumn-explorer.before: Sized L and cut boxy on purpose, with room for a thick jumper underneath — a jacket that fits nobody in particular fits almost everybody. It is unlined and wind-resistant rather than warm, so treat it as a korean fashion jacket for the shoulder seasons and put a coat over it in January. The tie cuffs are the sizing on the sleeve: pull them in for a sharper line, leave them loose over a knit.

bear-motif-knit-vest.heading: Why we took this one
bear-motif-knit-vest.lead: The single most asked-about thing in the shop. He is knitted in rather than printed on, so he will not crack or peel, and he is wearing a tiny hoodie of his own.
ways: Plain — over a crisp white tee.
Preppy — over a collared shirt with the collar out.
Below — jeans or a cord skirt, and nothing else with a motif on it.
bear-motif-knit-vest.before: One size. The bear is knitted into the panel rather than appliquéd on, so there is nothing to peel off in a wash — but wash it cold and dry it flat anyway, because the motif and the ground shrink at different rates. One piece of whimsy per outfit, and this spends it. Grey or beige; the beige is the softer of the two. Among cute clothes to wear it is the one bought for a niece and kept.

beaute-angel-queens-cushion-15g-long-las.heading: Why it is on the shelf
beaute-angel-queens-cushion-15g-long-las.lead: A cushion is the one piece of makeup worth carrying: ten seconds, no mirror ritual, no brush to clean. We stock the shade most people here actually wear rather than a wall of them.
ways: Ten seconds — two or three presses over the centre of the face, blended outwards.
Building — a second layer only where you want it, never all over.
Four o'clock — pressed over the day's makeup rather than reapplied under it.
beaute-angel-queens-cushion-15g-long-las.before: Shade #21 is the lighter of the two standard Korean shades and the one most people here wear; it is sheer enough at the edges to blend without a visible jaw line, but it will not cover a deeper skin tone. Press, do not sweep — a korean cushion compact applied with a dragging motion goes patchy. Wash the puff weekly and replace it before you replace the compact; a tired puff is the usual reason a cushion stops behaving.

beaute-glutathione-vitamin-ampoule-balm.heading: Why it is on the shelf
beaute-glutathione-vitamin-ampoule-balm.lead: An ampoule in a bottle stays on the bathroom shelf. In a twist-up compact it goes in a bag and gets used on the patch that needs it, which is the point of a brightening product in the first place.
ways: Targeted — pressed onto the sides of the nose, around the mouth, anywhere a mark is fading.
Over makeup — it sits on top of a cushion compact without moving it.
In a bag — the compact is the point; this is the korean ampoule that leaves the bathroom.
beaute-glutathione-vitamin-ampoule-balm.before: This is a targeted product rather than a routine one — a glutathione balm is for the patches you can point at, not for a whole face, and treating it as a moisturiser is the quickest way to get through it for nothing. Brightening is slow: give it six to eight weeks. Keep it out of a hot bag in summer, because a balm this soft will slump above about 30°C and will not re-form the same way.

beaute-vita-collagen-tone-up-cream-45ml-.heading: Why it is on the shelf
beaute-vita-collagen-tone-up-cream-45ml-.lead: Most tone-up creams are tacky enough that you only wear them once. This one finishes dewy and sits under everything else, so it reads as skin rather than as a product you put on.
beaute-vita-collagen-tone-up-cream-45ml-.wear: The last step of a morning routine, two fingers' worth for face and neck. On its own for a day with no makeup planned, or as the base under a cushion compact. Reapply through the day if you are outside — the brightening effect fades before the protection does, so trust the clock rather than your reflection.
ways: No-makeup day — on its own, as the only thing on your face.
Under a cushion — as the base, where the dewy finish does the work of a primer.
Reapplied — by the clock rather than by your reflection; the brightening fades first.
beaute-vita-collagen-tone-up-cream-45ml-.before: A tone up sunscreen brightens as it goes on, which means it also needs blending at the jaw and the hairline like a base would. 45ml lasts longer than it sounds because a tone-up needs less than a chalky white cream does, but do not ration it — the protection is only as good as the quantity. If you have reacted to a korean sun cream before, patch this behind an ear for a night; the collagen and the pigment are both new variables.

belted-shirt-dress.heading: Why we took this one
belted-shirt-dress.lead: A self-tie belt means the waist sits where yours is rather than where a pattern cutter guessed. The skirt is full enough to move and plain enough to wear to work.
ways: Weekday — belted, with boots.
Layered — open over wide trousers, as a long shirt.
Seasons — flat sandals in summer, tights and a boot in winter.
belted-shirt-dress.before: Alpha sizing, with the belt doing the shaping — which means the fit is forgiving and the proportion is yours to set. Four colours; the taupe and the grey are the quiet ones and the cream is the one that needs care. Worn open over trousers it stops being a dress at all, which doubles what you bought. For petite dresses casual searches it is the shape that works without an alteration.

bonny-hill-straw-berry-collagen-heartlea.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonny-hill-straw-berry-collagen-heartlea.lead: Toner pads replaced bottled toner here almost overnight, because you use the right amount without thinking about it. This is the one for brightness, with enough heartleaf in it not to sting.
bonny-hill-straw-berry-collagen-heartlea.wear: Sweep one over a cleansed face, following the lines of the face outwards, morning or night. Or lay a pad flat on a patch that needs it — a red cheek, a dull forehead — for three or four minutes and then press in what is left. Follow with a serum and a cream as usual.
ways: Morning — one pad swept outwards over a cleansed face, before serum.
Targeted — laid flat on a dull forehead or a red cheek for three or four minutes.
Neck and hands — whatever is left on the pad, rather than throwing it away.
bonny-hill-straw-berry-collagen-heartlea.before: Sixty pads in the jar: two months at once a day, one at twice. A collagen toner pad exfoliates lightly as you wipe, so if you also use an acid elsewhere in your routine, do not use both on the same evening. Use the tongs rather than dipping a hand in, and press the lid down firmly — a jar left open dries from the top down and the last twenty pads are the ones that suffer.

bonnyhill-ampoule-mask-sheet.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-ampoule-mask-sheet.lead: The quickest way to find out whether an ingredient suits you is twenty minutes with it on your face, not six weeks and a full-size bottle. Three versions, so you can test three answers.
bonnyhill-ampoule-mask-sheet.wear: Over a cleansed, toned face. Fifteen to twenty minutes is enough. Peel it off, press in what is left rather than rinsing, and follow with a moisturiser to seal it. Twice a week is plenty; a sheet mask is a treatment rather than a step.
ways: After cleansing — on a toned face, fifteen to twenty minutes and no longer.
Before an evening — the hydrating face mask an hour before you need to look awake.
Testing — one of each of the three, to find out which ingredient your skin likes.
bonnyhill-ampoule-mask-sheet.before: Twice a week is plenty; a korean sheet mask is a treatment rather than a step, and more often does not do more. Do not leave it on past twenty minutes — once the sheet dries it starts taking moisture back out of the skin. Press in what is left rather than rinsing, and follow with a moisturiser to seal it. If a particular ampoule mask stings, that is information: stop and try a different one of the three.

bonnyhill-honeybee-propolis-cream.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-honeybee-propolis-cream.lead: Every winter somebody comes in with skin that has stopped behaving and a routine of nine products. This is the one we hand them: thick, uncomplicated, and nothing in it trying to be clever.
ways: Winter nights — the last step, over a serum, warmed between the fingers first.
Rescue — the only step on a day when your skin has stopped cooperating.
Patches — in summer, on the dry areas rather than the whole face.
bonnyhill-honeybee-propolis-cream.before: This is a dry skin cream at the heavy end of a routine, and oily skin will prefer it at night only. 170ml is a large pot and it will last a season of winter evenings. Warm it between the fingers before it goes on; a propolis cream this thick drags if you apply it cold. Propolis is a bee product — if you react to honey or to bee stings, this is not the korean moisturizer for you.

bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-heartleaf-t.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-heartleaf-t.lead: The plainest thing on the skincare shelf and the one we restock most. No acid, no fruit, nothing to react to — which is exactly what reactive skin is looking for.
ways: Twice a day — one pad swept outwards over clean skin, morning and night.
On a flare — two pads laid flat over a red patch for five minutes.
Instead of serum — they leave enough essence behind that the next step is optional.
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-heartleaf-t.before: This is the plainest korean toner pad we carry and that is the whole point: no acid, no fruit extract, nothing to react to. If your skin is currently unhappy with something else, a heartleaf toner is the right place to retreat to while it settles. Sixty pads — a month at twice a day. Use the tongs rather than a hand, and keep the lid pressed down; a sensitive skin toner that has dried out in the jar is no use to anybody.

bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-rice-niacin.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-rice-niacin.lead: Two actives most people were buying separately, in one pot, at the price of one of them. If your routine has grown to six steps, this is where to start cutting.
ways: Morning — after serum, under sunscreen, where it layers without pilling.
Night — as the last step over whatever you are treating with.
Simplifying — in place of two products, if your routine has grown to six steps.
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-rice-niacin.before: Niacinamide is one of the few actives that gets on with almost everything else, so a niacinamide cream rarely complicates a routine that already works. 100ml is about three months at twice a day. A rice extract cream is mild enough for most skin, but if you have reacted to niacinamide at high concentrations before, patch it for a night first. This is the korean moisturizer to keep when you are cutting the rest.

brushed-check-overshirt.heading: Why we took this one
brushed-check-overshirt.lead: Soft from the first wear rather than the fiftieth, which is the only test a flannel has to pass. Six colourways, because this is the piece people come back for in another colour.
ways: Buttoned — with jeans, as a shirt.
Open — over a white tee, as a light jacket.
Tied — round the waist when the afternoon warms up.
brushed-check-overshirt.before: One size and genuinely oversized, so it goes over a long-sleeved top as an October jacket. Six colours, which is more choice than most things here get — the navy and the dark brown are the quiet ones, the hot pink is not. Brushed flannel pills where a bag strap rubs; a comb twice a season fixes it. Of all our comfy cute clothes this is the one that ends up living in the back of a car, which is a compliment.

cat-motif-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
cat-motif-cardigan.lead: The cats are knitted into the body, not appliquéd on, and the contrast placket keeps the whole thing from tipping into novelty. Cream, so it goes with everything you own.
ways: Plain — over a white tee and straight jeans.
Preppy — over a shirt with the collar out.
Layered — under a long coat, where the motif shows at the opening.
cat-motif-cardigan.before: Alpha sizing, in cream, which goes with everything and is most of why it sells — and which also means it shows a mark, so wash it before the mark sets rather than after. The cat is knitted into the panel rather than appliquéd, so there is nothing to peel off. One decorated garment per outfit. Among aesthetic cute clothes it is the piece that reads as charm rather than as costume.

celestial-midnight-a-line-gown.heading: Why we took this one
celestial-midnight-a-line-gown.lead: Long dresses are usually bought for one evening and then hang there. This one is knit on top and corduroy below, so it is warm enough to actually wear in the months you are invited to things.
ways: Evening — a heel, a flat gold earring, and nothing at the neck.
Winter — a long wool coat over it and opaque tights underneath.
Daytime — the brown colourway with flat boots, which is the easier of the two to wear.
celestial-midnight-a-line-gown.before: One size, and the measurements are not a typo: bust 34–46 inches, waist 30–40 inches, because the knit genuinely covers that span. At 42 inches long the hem skims the ankle on a shorter frame rather than pooling, which is why it works among petite dresses evening wear without a hem alteration. Do not put a necklace against the brushstrokes. Dry clean, or wash cold in a mesh bag and hang by the shoulders so the accordion pleats fall straight.

charming-embroidered-fair-isle-knit-vest.heading: Why we took this one
charming-embroidered-fair-isle-knit-vest.lead: The embroidery is stitched, not printed, which is the difference between a Christmas jumper and a piece of knitwear you keep. Look closely and there are little houses in it.
ways: Preppy — over a collared shirt with the collar out, which is the best of the three.
Easy — over a long-sleeved white tee and straight jeans.
December — over a cord skirt and tights, with a flat boot.
charming-embroidered-fair-isle-knit-vest.before: Sized L and cut to layer, so there is room for a shirt underneath without pulling at the armholes. Buttoned it reads neater; open it reads as a waistcoat. The motifs are embroidered and appliquéd rather than printed, so they will survive the washes a cute clothes for christmas piece normally does not. Hand wash cold and dry flat — the raised details will catch in a machine drum.

chic-sophisticated-ribbed-knit-a-line-mi.heading: Why we took this one
chic-sophisticated-ribbed-knit-a-line-mi.lead: A knit dress that does not cling is harder to find than it should be. This one smooths instead, and the belt comes with it, so you are not hunting for one that matches.
ways: Belted — with tall boots and a long coat, for a day that starts early.
Unbelted — with trainers and a tote, which is the weekend version.
Evening — belted, with a heel and the gold buttons doing the jewellery.
chic-sophisticated-ribbed-knit-a-line-mi.before: One size, fitting up to a US medium, and the knit smooths rather than grips. The belt comes with the dress and is not sewn in, which is deliberate — both versions are the point. Midi length, so the hem lands below the knee on most people and at mid-calf if you are petite. Among petite dresses casual pieces this is the one that needs the least thought, and it is the dress korean fashion shoppers come in describing rather than naming.

christian-dean-horse-oil-hand-moisturize.heading: Why it is on the shelf
christian-dean-horse-oil-hand-moisturize.lead: For hands that crack in winter, nothing light is going to do it. Horse oil leaves a layer on the surface rather than soaking straight in, which is the whole reason it works.
ways: By the sink — after every hand wash, which is when hands actually lose moisture.
Overnight — thickly, with cotton gloves, for two nights when hands have cracked.
Cuticles — worked in at the nail bed, where a light cream never reaches.
christian-dean-horse-oil-hand-moisturize.before: This is a heavy dry hands cream and it is meant to be: horse oil leaves a layer on the surface rather than soaking straight in, which is what makes it work and also what makes it the wrong thing to put on before typing. Keep a lighter korean hand cream in a bag and this one by the tap. 100ml, and it lasts because you only need a little.

command-attention-the-effortless-wide-le.heading: Why we took this one
command-attention-the-effortless-wide-le.lead: Cargo trousers in stiff cotton drill are a young person's game. These are cut from something soft enough to drape, so the volume falls instead of standing away from you.
command-attention-the-effortless-wide-le.wear: Balance the volume with something fitted on top — a cropped top, a close knit, anything tucked. Chunky trainers or boots underneath; a delicate shoe disappears under this much fabric. The khaki is the one that reads as utility, the black as the one that goes to dinner.
ways: Street — a cropped top, chunky trainers, and the drawstring pulled in.
Smart — a close black knit tucked in with a flat boot, in the classic black.
Summer — the beige with a fitted tee and a flat sandal.
command-attention-the-effortless-wide-le.before: An unusually generous span: M fits a 26–38 inch waist, L a 27–42, XL a 28–43, with the drawstring doing the work. If you are between sizes, take the smaller one. Rise runs 14 to 15 inches and inseam 27 to 28, so they sit high and finish at the ankle on most people. Balance the volume with something fitted on top — these are korean fashion pants that make the outfit, so let them.

cozy-chic-effortless-cool-the-collared-h.heading: Why we took this one
cozy-chic-effortless-cool-the-collared-h.lead: One zip, two sweaters. Up to the chin on a cold platform, down to the collarbone with a chain showing — and the brushed knit is warm without the bulk of a cable.
ways: Zipped — to the chin with black trousers, which is the version that reads considered.
Open — to the collarbone over a white tee and light denim.
Layered — over a collared shirt with the collar out, under a long coat.
cozy-chic-effortless-cool-the-collared-h.before: One size, relaxed through the body and cropped just enough to want a high waist under it — over a low-rise trouser it will look like a mistake. The collar stands on its own rather than folding flat, which is what keeps it looking deliberate with the zip down. For korean style winter wear this is the layer that goes under a coat without bulking at the shoulder.

dermacrew-exosome-all-in-one-ampoule.heading: Why it is on the shelf
dermacrew-exosome-all-in-one-ampoule.lead: The most concentrated thing we sell, and the one customers ask the most questions about. We would rather answer questions than stock something nobody is curious about.
ways: Evening — a few drops after toner, before cream, pressed rather than rubbed.
Slowly — two or three nights a week until you know how your skin takes it.
Targeted — on the areas you are actually working on rather than the whole face.
dermacrew-exosome-all-in-one-ampoule.before: A korean ampoule at this concentration is a commitment rather than a casual purchase. Introduce it slowly, do not layer it with a retinol on the same night to begin with, and wear sunscreen the next morning. A firming serum takes two to three months to show anything, so judge it on that timescale rather than on a fortnight. If your skin stings for more than a moment, dilute it into your moisturiser instead of applying it neat.

drawstring-wide-leg-trousers.heading: Why we took this one
drawstring-wide-leg-trousers.lead: The slits at the hem are the detail: a wide leg usually swallows whatever is on your feet, and these do not. Worn to the airport and to dinner in the same week.
ways: Dressed up — a tucked-in blouse and heels, which the button slits reward.
Plain — a tee, which does not; the trousers deserve better.
Shoes — a loafer or a block heel rather than a trainer, because the slit shows it.
drawstring-wide-leg-trousers.before: One size, with the drawstring doing the sizing and a soft knit keeping the wide leg from standing away from the body. The buttoned slits at the hem are the detail, and they frame whatever shoe you put under them — which is a reason to think about the shoe first. Four colours; the ivory shows the most and the grey gets worn the most. The easiest korean fashion pants to wear all day.

effortless-charm-the-modern-midi-dress-w.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-charm-the-modern-midi-dress-w.lead: The dress is plain on purpose; the heart on the zip pull is the only thing on it asking for attention. That is a better joke than a print, and it survives being worn to work.
effortless-charm-the-modern-midi-dress-w.wear: Boots and a coat for a weekday; heels and small earrings for an evening. The ivory wants bare legs or sheer tights, the black takes opaque. Keep the neckline empty — the heart pull is the jewellery.
ways: Day — zipped to the collarbone, with boots and a coat.
Evening — zipped to the top, a heel, small earrings, nothing at the neck.
Layered — over a fine polo neck in January, with the zip left open.
effortless-charm-the-modern-midi-dress-w.before: Chest 38–42 inches, length 41 inches, cut to a US small. At 41 inches the hem lands mid-calf rather than at the shin, which is the length that works on a petite frame without being taken up — one of the few petite dresses casual pieces here that needs nothing doing to it. The ivory wants bare legs or sheer tights; the black takes opaque. Keep the neckline empty, because the heart on the zip pull is the only thing meant to be looked at.

effortless-chic-ribbed-lounge-pants.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-chic-ribbed-lounge-pants.lead: There is a version of these in every shop and most of them bag at the knee by the second wearing. The rib on these holds, which is the only thing that separates lounge trousers from pyjamas.
effortless-chic-ribbed-lounge-pants.wear: A plain tee at home. A structured knit and loafers if they are leaving the house, which they will — a wide ribbed leg in black reads as tailoring from six feet away. Avoid anything oversized on top or the whole outfit becomes volume.
ways: At home — a plain tee and bare feet, which is what they were bought for.
Out — a structured knit and loafers; the wide rib reads as tailoring from six feet away.
Travel — with a long cardigan and trainers, because they do not crease.
effortless-chic-ribbed-lounge-pants.before: Cut to a 25–26 inch waist with the elastic covering a good deal more. Inseam 28.5 inches, rise 12 inches, so they sit mid-rise and finish at the ankle on most people. Avoid anything oversized on top — a wide ribbed leg and a loose jumper is a lot of volume in one outfit. As korean fashion pants go these are the ones most likely to be worn four days a week, so buy the black if you are only buying one.

effortless-chic-the-everyday-essential-s.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-chic-the-everyday-essential-s.lead: A full trench is a commitment and a lot of fabric. Cut to the hip it keeps every detail that makes a trench a trench and goes over a dress without swallowing it.
ways: Spring — over jeans and a tee, sleeves pushed to the elbow.
Autumn — over a midi dress and boots, which is the better of the two.
Winter — under a longer coat, which the short cut allows and a full trench does not.
effortless-chic-the-everyday-essential-s.before: Chest 48 inches, length 28 inches, sized L and cut relaxed so a knit goes under it comfortably. It is a three-season korean fashion jacket rather than a winter coat: light enough for a crisp spring day, right for layering in autumn, and happiest under something heavier in January. The spread collar will stand if you turn it up, which is worth doing on a windy day.

effortless-chic-the-safari-inspired-midi.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-chic-the-safari-inspired-midi.lead: The layered hem is attached, which sounds like a small thing until you have spent a day pulling a shirt down under a cropped jumper. The script across the front is embroidered, not printed.
ways: Balanced — over wide-leg trousers, where the crop and the volume meet properly.
Long — over a midi skirt, with a flat boot.
Simple — over high-waisted straight jeans, with nothing underneath it.
effortless-chic-the-safari-inspired-midi.before: One size, cut loose on purpose, with the white hem layer attached so it stays where you put it. The sleeves are generous and the body is short — this is a shape that wants a high waist beneath it and will not work over a low-rise jean. The script is embroidered rather than printed, so it survives the wash, but wash it cold and dry it flat: the knit and the woven hem shrink at different rates in a machine. For korean fashion winter it layers under a coat without bulk.

effortless-flow-denim-collection.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-flow-denim-collection.lead: A pale denim that is not white is the one most people are missing. This wash has grey in it, so it behaves like a neutral instead of like a summer novelty.
ways: Plain — a black tee and trainers, which is the whole outfit.
Smart — a cream knit tucked in with loafers and a tan belt.
Tonal — with cream or oatmeal on top, where the grey in the wash does the work.
effortless-flow-denim-collection.before: Rise 10.5 inches, inseam 31 inches, cut to a 29–30 inch waist and mid-rise rather than high. Pale denim shows everything, so these are not the pair for a day with a toddler or a bicycle. If you already own blue jeans, these are the korean fashion jeans to buy next — they do more for a plain top than another indigo pair will. Wash them inside out and cold; the melange is woven rather than bleached, but it still dulls in a hot wash.

effortless-texture-the-cozy-ribbed-maxi-.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-texture-the-cozy-ribbed-maxi-.lead: This is the piece people build a season around: knit, floor-length, no fastening to think about. We take it in both colours every time it comes up.
ways: Winter — the cream with a chunky knit and boots.
Summer — the black with a tucked-in cami and flat sandals.
Layered — either colour under a long coat, where the rib shows at the hem.
effortless-texture-the-cozy-ribbed-maxi-.before: Waist 26–36 inches, length 31 inches, one size, and the span on the waist is real rather than optimistic. On a shorter frame the hem sits at the ankle rather than on the floor, which is the right place for it. Keep the top half fitted — a long skirt and a loose jumper is a lot of fabric. This is the korean fashion skirt people build a season around, and both colours sell before the rest of the order is unpacked.

ekel-hyaluronic-acid-4-in-1-sun-cream.heading: Why it is on the shelf
ekel-hyaluronic-acid-4-in-1-sun-cream.lead: Most people who say they hate sunscreen mean they hate the white cast. This one goes on clear and hydrates enough to replace the moisturiser step for a lot of people.
ways: Every morning — the last step, two fingers' length for face and neck.
Instead of moisturiser — for a lot of people the hyaluronic acid makes that step unnecessary.
Under makeup — it absorbs fast enough not to pill under a base.
ekel-hyaluronic-acid-4-in-1-sun-cream.before: A no white cast sunscreen removes the usual objection, but it still needs applying at the tested quantity — about two fingers' length — or the SPF50+ on the tube is theoretical. Reapply through the day if you are out in it. If your skin runs very dry in winter, keep a moisturiser underneath; the four-in-one claim holds up in spring and summer more than in January. A good first korean sun cream for anyone who has given up on them.

eshumi-sun-cream-spf-50-pa-70ml.heading: Why it is on the shelf
eshumi-sun-cream-spf-50-pa-70ml.lead: The big tube at a sensible price, which matters more than any ingredient list — nobody applies enough sunscreen when they are rationing it. This is the one that runs out fastest here.
ways: Daily — last step in the morning, before makeup.
Reapplied — every two or three hours when you are outside.
In a bag — the 70ml tube is the one to carry rather than ration.
eshumi-sun-cream-spf-50-pa-70ml.before: Two fingers' length is the dose for a face and neck; most people use half that and get half the protection, which is the main reason an spf 50 sunscreen disappoints. A vitamin e sunscreen is a reasonable way to get an antioxidant in at the same time, but it is not a substitute for a serum. This is a daily korean sun cream rather than a beach one — if you are swimming, take the waterproof tube instead.

eshumi-vitamin-hand-cream.heading: Why it is on the shelf
eshumi-vitamin-hand-cream.lead: A hand cream you can use and then immediately pick up your phone. That sounds trivial and it is the reason this tube gets used ten times a day and the rich one does not.
ways: At a desk — whenever you think of it, because it dries instantly.
After washing — which is when hands actually lose the moisture.
In a bag — the tube that goes out with you, rather than the heavy one at home.
eshumi-vitamin-hand-cream.before: A non greasy hand cream is a different product from an overnight one, and this is firmly the first: it keeps hands comfortable through a day but it will not repair cracked skin in January. Keep a heavier korean hand cream by the bed for that. Nothing in it conflicts with gel nails or hand sanitiser, and it will not leave a film on a phone screen, which is most of why it gets used.

faux-fur-gilet.heading: Why we took this one
faux-fur-gilet.lead: The warmth of a coat across the body with none of the bulk at the arm, which is the whole argument for a fur vest. Four colours, because it is the piece people buy twice.
ways: Daytime — the brown or black over jeans, a long-sleeved tee and boots.
Evening — the white or grey over something you are wearing out.
Layered — over a fine knit rather than a bulky one, so the volume stays in one place.
faux-fur-gilet.before: Sized S–M and cut cropped at the waist. Because it is open and sleeveless the sizing is forgiving — what goes underneath decides the shape. Keep the sleeves beneath slim; a fur vest over a chunky jumper is a great deal of volume in one place. It gives you the warmth of a coat across the body without the bulk at the arm, which is the whole argument, and for cute clothes for cold weather it does more for an outfit than anything else at this price.

fine-knit-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
fine-knit-cardigan.lead: A turtleneck and a cardigan in one garment, because the buttons keep going up through the neck. Four colours, and it is under a coat in January and over a dress in May.
ways: January — buttoned to the chin under a coat.
May — open over a tee.
Any other month — over a dress, as a cardigan.
fine-knit-cardigan.before: One size, in a fine knit that buttons from the mock neck down, so it works as a jumper and as a cardigan without compromising at either. Four colours; the oatmeal and the black are the ones people own two of. Fine knit pills where a bag strap rubs — take a comb to it twice a season and it will last years. It is the most-worn shape we sell, which is not a complaint, and the easiest korean fashion winter layer to pack.

flared-skater-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
flared-skater-skirt.lead: One of the few things in the shop that works with trainers and with heels, which is why we keep reordering it. A double knit with enough body to swing when you turn.
ways: Daytime — a fitted knit and trainers.
Evening — a plain black top and a heel.
Winter — opaque tights from November, with a flat boot.
flared-skater-skirt.before: Sized in alpha sizes, with the flare coming from the cut rather than from a petticoat, so it moves without standing away from you. The waistband sits at the natural waist and the hem lands above the knee. The red is the one that needs everything else plain; black and cobalt will share an outfit. Among petite dresses casual pairings this korean fashion skirt is the half that makes a plain top into something.

flirty-fun-the-cold-shoulder-comfort-swe.heading: Why we took this one
flirty-fun-the-cold-shoulder-comfort-swe.lead: One change to a shape everyone already owns. It is the top for the week in between seasons, when sleeves are too much and bare arms are not enough.
flirty-fun-the-cold-shoulder-comfort-swe.wear: Jeans, a skirt or shorts — it works over all three without needing anything else. The brights are the ones that sell first: the peach and the lime do more for a plain outfit than the white does.
ways: Jeans — straight, high-waisted, with trainers.
Skirt — a knit midi, which turns it into something closer to an outfit.
Shorts — the brights in summer, where the cut-outs make sense of the sleeves.
flirty-fun-the-cold-shoulder-comfort-swe.before: Chest 27–42 inches, length 22.5 inches, one size, and the stretch genuinely covers that span. The cut-outs sit on the shoulder rather than off it, so a normal bra strap stays hidden. Five colours, and the peach and the lime do more for a plain outfit than the white does. Among casual cute clothes it is the one for the week between seasons, when sleeves are too much and bare arms are not enough.

for-the-skin-collagen-gommage-peeling.heading: Why it is on the shelf
for-the-skin-collagen-gommage-peeling.lead: We stopped recommending scrubs years ago and needed something to recommend instead. A gommage rolls off as it dries, so there is nothing abrasive and it is very hard to overdo.
for-the-skin-collagen-gommage-peeling.wear: On dry skin, after cleansing and before anything else. Spread it, wait a minute, then roll it off with light fingers and rinse. Once or twice a week is plenty — it is very hard to overdo, which is most of why we stock it. Follow with a toner and a cream.
ways: Weekly — on dry skin after cleansing, rolled off and rinsed.
Before a mask — which is when a sheet mask does the most.
On the body — elbows and knees, where a gentle exfoliator is rarely used and most needed.
for-the-skin-collagen-gommage-peeling.before: Once or twice a week is plenty. A gommage peeling gel is very hard to overdo, which is most of why we stock it, but it is still exfoliation: do not use it on the same evening as an acid or a retinol. It must go on dry skin — on damp skin it will not set and will not roll. 180ml is a large tube and lasts most of a year, so this is the cheapest korean exfoliator per use on the shelf.

harvest-moon-high-rise-pant.heading: Why we took this one
harvest-moon-high-rise-pant.lead: Fleece-lined trousers usually look like what they are. These are cut as a proper high-waisted straight leg, so the warmth is a secret rather than the point.
ways: Smart — a fine polo neck tucked in with ankle boots.
Easy — a sweatshirt and trainers, which is what they get worn for most.
Tonal — with cream or charcoal on top, against the deep brown.
harvest-moon-high-rise-pant.before: Cut to a 27–28 inch waist, with an elastic back waistband that stretches to 32 and keeps the front flat. Rise 12 inches, inseam 26 inches, so they sit high and finish above the ankle — a boot rather than a trainer in winter. They are fleece-lined, which makes them considerably warmer than they look and too warm for an overheated office. As cute clothes for cold weather go these are the trousers that mean you can stop wearing thermals.

hera-sets.heading: Why it is on the shelf
hera-sets.lead: If one habit changes somebody's skin it is double cleansing, and it fails at the first step because water will not touch sunscreen. This is the set we start people on.
hera-sets.wear: On dry skin and dry hands. Massage for a minute, add water to emulsify until it turns milky, then rinse and follow with a foaming cleanser. Evening only — there is nothing to remove in the morning.
ways: First cleanse — on dry skin and dry hands, massaged for a minute before water.
Eye makeup — worked gently over closed eyes rather than scrubbed at.
Sunscreen days — which is every day, and the only thing that reliably takes it off.
hera-sets.before: A korean cleansing oil goes on dry: wet hands stop it dissolving anything. Massage, add water until it turns milky, then rinse and follow with a foaming cleanser — that second step is what makes it a double cleanse rather than half of one. Evening only; there is nothing to remove in the morning. If your skin is very oily this is still worth doing, because oil dissolves oil and a makeup remover that leaves a film is usually a cheap one, not an oil one.

heritage-chevron-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
heritage-chevron-cardigan.lead: The buttons are doing the work of jewellery, which is why the cardigan is finished with nothing else on it. Both colourways sell; the pink goes first.
ways: As a top — buttoned, with wide trousers and nothing underneath.
Open — over a white shirt with the collar out.
Layered — under a long coat, where the gold buttons show at the opening.
heritage-chevron-cardigan.before: Sized S–M with the stretch covering more than that. It is cropped to the waist rather than the hip, so it sits above a high-waisted trouser or skirt cleanly and will leave a gap over a low-rise one. Keep the rest plain: stripes and a second pattern is one thing too many. Both colourways sell and the pink goes first, which is worth knowing if you are deciding. A cute clothes aesthetic piece with one good detail and nothing else trying.

heritage-crest-ribbed-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
heritage-crest-ribbed-cardigan.lead: A column dress lives or dies by whether it holds its line through a long dinner. The elastic waist and the fine rib are what let this one do that without gripping anywhere.
heritage-crest-ribbed-cardigan.wear: Nothing at the neck — the crest is the detail and a necklace will crowd it. A heel and a wool coat for an evening; flat boots and a long cardigan for the version that goes to work. The grey is the easier daytime colour.
ways: Evening — a heel, a wool coat, and nothing at the neck.
Work — flat boots and a long cardigan over the top.
Winter — opaque tights and a tall boot, with the pleats showing below the coat.
heritage-crest-ribbed-cardigan.before: Sized S–M with the stretch covering more than that. The waistband is elastic, which matters on a fitted shape — it holds the line through a long dinner rather than seating out. The hem sits below the knee, and at mid-calf on a petite frame. Do not put a necklace near the crest; it is the only ornament on the dress and the reason it works as a korean fashion formal dress without any jewellery at all.

heritage-houndstooth-a-line-midi.heading: Why we took this one
heritage-houndstooth-a-line-midi.lead: The check is woven rather than printed, so it has depth to it close up. The flounce at the hem is what stops it reading as a uniform skirt.
heritage-houndstooth-a-line-midi.wear: A cream knit tucked in and tall boots. A black polo neck and loafers for the office version. The green in the check is the one to pick up elsewhere if you pick up anything; most people are better off leaving it alone.
ways: Office — a black polo neck tucked in with flat loafers.
Weekend — a cream knit and tall boots.
Evening — a fine black top and a heel, letting the flounce do the work.
heritage-houndstooth-a-line-midi.before: Length 26 inches, cut to a 25–26 inch waist, with no stretch in the waistband — size up if you are between. Fully lined with a hidden back zip, so nothing clings to tights. On a shorter frame the hem sits just below the knee rather than mid-calf, which is the better length for this shape. For petite clothes for work it is a korean fashion skirt that reads serious from the waist up and has an opinion at the hem.

high-rise-metropolitan-straight-leg-jean.heading: Why we took this one
high-rise-metropolitan-straight-leg-jean.lead: A 24 inch inseam on a straight-leg jean is unusual and it is the reason these are here. They are meant to end above the boot, so a shorter leg looks deliberate rather than altered.
ways: Boots — leather ankle boots, which the short inseam is designed to show.
Heels — a sleek heel with a knit tucked in, for the evening version.
Layered — with a long coat, where the ankle break keeps the line clean.
high-rise-metropolitan-straight-leg-jean.before: The back of the waistband is elastic, which is what makes the sizing generous: the S stretches to a 27 inch waist, the L to 32. Rise 11 inches, inseam 24 inches. That inseam is the unusual part and the reason to buy them — for petite clothes for women it means no hemming at all. They will look odd with a trainer unless you are short enough for the hem to sit on the shoe, so think boots first.

holika-holika-soda-pore-cleansing-deep-c.heading: Why it is on the shelf
holika-holika-soda-pore-cleansing-deep-c.lead: Oily skin by lunchtime and blackheads round the nose is the most common thing people ask us about. This has been in production long enough to have earned the shelf space.
holika-holika-soda-pore-cleansing-deep-c.wear: Evening, as the second half of a double cleanse after an oil. Something milder in the morning if your skin runs dry anywhere. Twice a day is too much for most people in winter — if your skin feels tight afterwards, that is the sign.
ways: Evening — the second cleanse, after an oil.
Morning — only if your skin is oily; skip it if it is not.
Nose and chin — worked a little longer where blackheads collect.
holika-holika-soda-pore-cleansing-deep-c.before: A small amount worked up in wet hands is enough, and more than that will leave you tight. If your skin feels squeaky afterwards you have used too much or washed too often — an oily skin cleanser works by removing excess, not everything. Twice a day is too much for most people in winter. The soda beads dissolve as you work them, so there is nothing abrasive left on your face by the time you rinse.

iconic-70s-flair-wide-leg-denim.heading: Why we took this one
iconic-70s-flair-wide-leg-denim.lead: A flare needs the right shoe under it or the hem drags, which is why most shops do not stock them. Worn properly these change how you stand, and that is worth the trouble.
iconic-70s-flair-wide-leg-denim.wear: A fitted knit or a tucked-in tee keeps the proportion honest. A platform or a block heel under them. Nothing cropped on top — a short top and a long flare leaves nothing in the middle.
ways: Heel — a platform or a block, so the hem clears the ground.
Fitted top — a knit or a tucked-in tee, to balance the leg.
Long coat — which follows the line of the flare rather than cutting across it.
iconic-70s-flair-wide-leg-denim.before: Rise 13 inches, inseam 29.5 inches, two sizes on the waist. They are cut for a heel: on a shorter frame they will need one, or a boot with some height, or the hem will drag. Nothing cropped on top — a short top and a long flare leaves nothing in the middle. These are the korean fashion jeans with the most attitude in the shop, and they change how you stand, which is either the point or the problem depending on the day.

iconic-cool-the-varsity-inspired-bomber-.heading: Why we took this one
iconic-cool-the-varsity-inspired-bomber-.lead: Microsuede rather than satin, and piping rather than a logo. It is the varsity shape with everything collegiate taken out of it except the proportions.
iconic-cool-the-varsity-inspired-bomber-.wear: Jeans and a white tee is the obvious outfit and the piping is what lifts it. Over a midi dress it reads as deliberate. The camel is the one that goes with everything; the black is the sharper of the two.
ways: Classic — jeans and a white tee, where the piping does the lifting.
Unexpected — over a midi dress with boots.
Layered — over a knit in October, under nothing; it is a cool-evening jacket.
iconic-cool-the-varsity-inspired-bomber-.before: Sized M and slightly relaxed through the body so it layers over a knit. Cropped at the waist, which wants a high-waisted trouser or skirt underneath. Mid-weight microsuede: this is a korean fashion jacket for a cool evening rather than a cold day, so plan a coat for January. The camel goes with everything; the black is the sharper of the two and the one that reads least collegiate.

j-vita-anti-uv-vita-collagen.heading: Why it is on the shelf
j-vita-anti-uv-vita-collagen.lead: Waterproof is the one claim on a sunscreen that actually changes your day. This is the tube for a beach or a long walk; keep a lighter one for the office.
ways: Beach — twenty minutes before you go out, and again after every swim.
Long walks — where sweat takes an ordinary sunscreen off within the hour.
Alongside — rather than instead of your daily tube; keep one of each.
j-vita-anti-uv-vita-collagen.before: A waterproof sunscreen is the only claim on a sun cream that actually changes your day, but waterproof does not mean permanent — reapply after swimming or towelling off regardless of what the label survives. It is a little more substantial on the skin than the everyday tubes, which is the trade for staying put. Suitable for all skin types including sensitive skin, though patch it first if sunscreen has stung you before.

jigott-whitening-uv-sun-block-cream.heading: Why it is on the shelf
jigott-whitening-uv-sun-block-cream.lead: Jigott is one of the houses we buy from most often, and this is the tube that comes back into stock fastest after it sells out. Seventy millilitres is enough to use properly.
ways: City — under makeup, as the last step of a morning routine.
Beach — reapplied every two hours, generously.
Neck and chest — which is where sun damage shows first and sunscreen reaches last.
jigott-whitening-uv-sun-block-cream.before: 70ml is large enough to use properly rather than ration, which is the main reason most people under-apply. A uv sun block cream with a brightening formula evens tone as it protects, but brightness is slow and protection is immediate — judge it on the second. This is one of the tubes that sells out fastest here, so if you get on with it, buy two.

kaleidoscope-color-block-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
kaleidoscope-color-block-cardigan.lead: Knitted in blocks rather than printed, so the colours meet at real seams. It is the loudest thing on the rail and the one most likely to get a stranger talking to you.
kaleidoscope-color-block-cardigan.wear: Everything else plain. Cream trousers, a white tee, done. Any second pattern and the cardigan stops being the joke and starts being a mess.
ways: Plain — cream trousers, a white tee, and nothing else saying anything.
Denim — straight jeans and white trainers.
Layered — over a plain dress, which is the version that surprises people.
kaleidoscope-color-block-cardigan.before: Sized S–M, cut relaxed, with nothing close-fitting about it. The one rule is that everything else stays plain: any second pattern and the cardigan stops being a joke and starts being a mess. It is knitted in blocks rather than printed, so the colours meet at real seams — which is also why it is worth washing cold and flat rather than risking the colours in a hot machine. The loudest cute fashion style piece in the shop.

kissera-luxury-collagen-uv-sun-cream70ml.heading: Why it is on the shelf
kissera-luxury-collagen-uv-sun-cream70ml.lead: The one to start with if sunscreen has stung before. Aloe is the soothing part, and the texture spreads instead of dragging, which matters on skin that is already unhappy.
kissera-luxury-collagen-uv-sun-cream70ml.wear: Last step in the morning. If sunscreen has stung you before, patch it behind an ear for a night first — a sensitive skin sunscreen is still a product, and nothing suits everybody. Reapply through the day if you are outside.
ways: Daily — last step in the morning, spread rather than rubbed.
Reactive skin — patched behind an ear for a night before you commit to it.
Dry skin — over a moisturiser in winter, instead of one in summer.
kissera-luxury-collagen-uv-sun-cream70ml.before: A sensitive skin sunscreen is still a product and nothing suits everybody, so patch it first if sunscreen has stung you before. The aloe is the soothing part and the cream spreads without pulling, which matters on skin that is already unhappy. 70ml at the right quantity is a couple of months. This is the gentlest korean sun cream on our shelf and the one to start with rather than the one to graduate to.

kissera-pink-tone-up-collagen-sun-cream-.heading: Why it is on the shelf
kissera-pink-tone-up-collagen-sun-cream-.lead: The pink cancels sallowness rather than lightening anything, which is a distinction worth making. It is more wearable on more skin tones than the photographs suggest.
ways: Alone — on a day with no makeup planned, where it does a light base's job.
Under a cushion — as the step that makes the base sit properly.
Topped up — by the clock, because the brightening fades before the protection does.
kissera-pink-tone-up-collagen-sun-cream-.before: The pink cancels sallowness rather than lightening the skin, so the effect is a brighter face rather than a paler one — worth being clear about before you buy a pink tone up cream. It is more wearable on more skin tones than the photographs suggest, because the pigment diffuses rather than covers. Blend at the jaw and the hairline as you would a base. Three forms of collagen make it kinder to dry skin than most tone-up creams.

ks-collagen-and-retinol-soap.heading: Why it is on the shelf
ks-collagen-and-retinol-soap.lead: A gentle way into retinol, because a bar is on your face for twenty seconds rather than overnight. Start here if a retinol cream has stung before.
ks-collagen-and-retinol-soap.wear: Evening only, starting at three or four nights a week and building up if your skin is comfortable. Follow with a moisturiser every time. Sunscreen the next morning without exception — retinol in any form makes skin more sensitive to UV, and skipping that undoes the work.
ways: Evening — three or four nights a week to start, never in the morning.
Face only — keep it away from the eye area entirely.
Paired — with a plain moisturiser, not with another active on the same night.

For anyone shopping petite dress pants for women and tired of a 32 inch inseam, 27 is the number worth knowing. Keep the top half simple; the flare is the shape doing the work.

the-artisan-chevron-knit-co-ord.heading: Why we took this one
the-artisan-chevron-knit-co-ord.lead: The chevron border is what makes it look designed rather than merely matched. The vest layers over a shirt or a polo neck, so the set does not have to stay a set.
ways: Together — tonal, with a boot, which is the version it was designed for.
Vest — over a white shirt with jeans.
Skirt — with a fine knit tucked in, as a korean fashion skirt in its own right.
the-artisan-chevron-knit-co-ord.before: One size, fitting up to a US 12, roomy and with real stretch. The vest is cut to layer over a blouse, a tee or a polo neck, so the set does not have to stay a set — which is most of the value in it. The skirt runs from a wide elastic waistband into a proper flare with a drawstring you can use. The grey is the easier of the two colourways; the black is the sharper.

the-artisan-pleat-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-artisan-pleat-midi-skirt.lead: The stripe panel is set off-centre on purpose — it drags the eye diagonally and makes a pleated skirt look drawn rather than bought. One plain top is all it needs.
the-artisan-pleat-midi-skirt.wear: A cream knit or a plain black top and the skirt does all the work. Boots in winter, a flat sandal in summer. Nothing else striped, patterned or textured anywhere near it.
ways: Cream — a cream knit tucked in with a flat boot.
Black — a plain black top and a heel, letting the stripe panel do everything.
Summer — a white tee and a flat sandal.
the-artisan-pleat-midi-skirt.before: One size, with the waistband at the natural waist and the hem below the knee on most people. The pleats are knife-sharp and hold through a day in a chair, which is what separates a korean fashion skirt you keep reaching for from one you stop. Nothing else striped, patterned or textured anywhere near it. Dry clean or cold wash in a mesh bag, hung by the waistband — never folded across the pleats.

the-avenue-crest-long-sleeve-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-avenue-crest-long-sleeve-dress.lead: The contrast trim runs in one unbroken line from collar to hem, which is where the height comes from. It is the dress for a week that needs one thing you can wear for twelve hours.
the-avenue-crest-long-sleeve-dress.wear: A low heel and nothing at the neck. Flat boots and a long coat for a cold day. It is a one-garment outfit, which is the point of owning it.
ways: Work — a low heel and nothing at the neck.
Winter — flat boots and a long coat.
Evening — the same dress, a better shoe, and one earring that catches light.
the-avenue-crest-long-sleeve-dress.before: Cut to a US small with the hem at the knee. The sleeves are slim — if you have broader shoulders this is one to try before committing. The contrast trim runs in one unbroken line from collar to hem, which is where the height comes from, so nothing should cut across it: a belt would undo the whole design. A korean fashion formal dress restrained enough to wear weekly.

the-belted-wrap-knit-vest.heading: Why we took this one
the-belted-wrap-knit-vest.lead: A third piece is the hardest thing to buy well, and most of them are either a blazer that needs a shirt under it or a cardigan that reads as a dressing gown. This one ties, so it has whatever shape you give it that morning.
the-belted-wrap-knit-vest.wear: Over a long-sleeved tee and straight jeans in autumn, over a thin knit and trousers in January, over a blouse for an office that does not want a jacket. Belt it for a defined waist with wide-leg trousers; leave it open and long over a slim skirt. In grey it is the quietest of the three; the beige does the most for a tonal outfit, and the navy is the one that reads closest to tailoring.
ways: Weekday — over a long-sleeved tee and straight jeans, belted loosely, with a flat boot.
Office — over a blouse and wide-leg trousers, belt pulled in, for a room that does not want a jacket.
Weekend — open and long over a thin knit and a slim skirt, with the belt left in a drawer.
the-belted-wrap-knit-vest.before: One size, and the belt is what makes that honest rather than optimistic — it covers a 40 to 46 inch chest comfortably. The length sits at the top of the thigh, which is a flattering place for a hem to land on most people and a little lower if you are petite. Nothing is cut close, so what you wear underneath decides the shape. If you are new to korean style winter wear, a wrap vest is the easiest way in: it needs no fastening to get right and no particular shoe.

the-bronze-helm-explorer-slim-fit-jeans.heading: Why we took this one
the-bronze-helm-explorer-slim-fit-jeans.lead: Slim rather than skinny, which is the cut that has survived every swing of the last decade. The whiskering looks like wear rather than like a machine making a point about it.
ways: Boots — ankle boots and a tucked-in knit.
Trainers — with an untucked shirt, for a Saturday.
Loafers — with a blazer, which a slim leg takes and a wide one does not.
the-bronze-helm-explorer-slim-fit-jeans.before: Rise 10 inches, inseam 31 inches, cut to a 29–30 inch waist — a true mid-rise rather than a low one. The denim is sturdy with flex worked in, so they hold a line and still let you climb into a car. Slim rather than skinny, which is the cut that has survived every swing of the last decade. The most versatile korean clothes pants in the shop, if you only want one pair of jeans.

the-brunello-cucinelli-monili-straight-l.heading: Why we took this one
the-brunello-cucinelli-monili-straight-l.lead: The beading is set into the outside seam and catches the light when you move, which is the entire ornament on an otherwise plain trouser. A slim leg would crowd it; this one does not.
ways: Tonal — a cream knit and a camel jacket.
Sharp — a black polo neck, which throws the beading into relief.
Evening — a heel, because the stripe runs to the hem and wants to be seen.
the-brunello-cucinelli-monili-straight-l.before: Cut to a 27–28 inch waist, mid-to-high rise, finishing at the ankle. The beading is sewn into the seam rather than applied on top, so it does not catch on anything — but it is still beading: wash cold in a mesh bag and never tumble. Among petite clothes for work this is the pair to wear when there is a dinner afterwards, and the quietest korean fashion pants here with the most detail on them.

the-burgundy-knot-sheath-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-burgundy-knot-sheath-dress.lead: The knot at the waist is what takes the severity out of a pencil line, and it is the only thing happening on the dress. Desk in the morning, restaurant at night, one change of earrings.
ways: Work — a court shoe and a single necklace.
Dinner — the same dress, a change of earrings, a better bag.
Winter — opaque tights and a wool coat rather than a padded one.
the-burgundy-knot-sheath-dress.before: Cut to a US medium. A sheath is the least forgiving cut there is, so this is one to try rather than guess — the stretch crepe gives, but the line does not hide anything. The zip is hidden at the centre back and the neckline is deliberately empty so a necklace has somewhere to sit. Anything bulky over the top undoes the line. Among petite dresses special occasion options, the one you will wear more than once.

the-chic-minimalist-knit-blazer.heading: Why we took this one
the-chic-minimalist-knit-blazer.lead: The most expensive thing in the shop and the one still in rotation in five years. Seventy per cent wool, handmade, and it holds a shoulder line without a scrap of padding.
ways: Work — over a white shirt and straight trousers.
Weekend — over a tee and jeans, which is where a knit blazer beats a structured one.
Evening — over a slip dress, with the sleeves pushed up.
the-chic-minimalist-knit-blazer.before: Chest 42 inches, length 26 inches, sized L and cut to sit open rather than to fasten, so the fit across the back is forgiving. Seventy per cent wool and handmade: treat it as knitwear, not as a jacket — cold hand wash, dried flat, folded rather than hung, or the shoulders will drop within a season. For petite clothes for work a korean fashion jacket in knit solves the sleeve problem a structured one creates.

the-chic-minimalist-trench-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-chic-minimalist-trench-dress.lead: A coat pattern cut as a dress, which is half of what makes the Korean silhouette recognisable. The khaki-olive takes black, cream, brown and denim without an argument.
ways: Work — nude heels, a structured bag, sash tied.
Weekend — ankle boots, bare legs, sash loose.
Winter — belted, with a long coat over the top and tights underneath.
the-chic-minimalist-trench-dress.before: Cut to a US small. The sash runs either way — tied for a shape, left loose with the buttons doing the work — and both are the point. The lapel wants an empty neckline, so no scarf. Khaki-olive takes black, cream, brown and denim without argument, which is most of why this korean fashion casual dress gets worn as often as it does.

the-city-fringe-knit-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-city-fringe-knit-skirt.lead: A pencil skirt that behaves like a knit is a rare thing and this is the best one we have had. The fringe swings a half-beat behind you and does all the work.
ways: Day — a tucked-in cream blouse and a flat boot.
Evening — the same skirt with a heel and a black knit.
Never — with a loose jumper, which loses the pencil line entirely.
the-city-fringe-knit-skirt.before: Waist 26–32 inches, length 30 inches, one size, with an elastic waistband that holds the structured look without being rigid. The hem sits below the knee. Keep the top half close — a pencil skirt is a line, and anything oversized above it erases the line. A korean fashion skirt that behaves like tailoring and wears like a knit, which is the whole argument for it among petite clothes for work.

the-coziest-classic-heritage-cable-knit-.heading: Why we took this one
the-coziest-classic-heritage-cable-knit-.lead: Proper cables — raised and ropey, warm because of it rather than for decoration. The warmest thing we sell and the one most likely to be worn until it falls apart.
ways: Casual — the ivory over jeans and trainers.
Smart — the black over black trousers, at which point it stops reading casual.
Indoors — over a tee instead of a coat, which is what it is thick enough to replace.
the-coziest-classic-heritage-cable-knit-.before: One size, cut generously, with a real hood rather than a decorative one. Fold it rather than hang it; a cable knit this heavy will pull at the shoulders on a hanger. Three colours, and the grey marl hides wear best. For korean fashion winter it is the layer that makes a thin coat workable.

the-deconstructed-chic-trench-skirt-set.heading: Why we took this one
the-deconstructed-chic-trench-skirt-set.lead: The strongest thing we have ever stocked: a trench coat cut off at the waist with a mini skirt under it. Apart, the jacket goes over jeans and the skirt under a knit.
ways: Together — a boot and bare legs, which is the full version.
Jacket — over jeans and a tee, as a cropped trench.
Skirt — under a knit, which is how most of it actually gets worn.
the-deconstructed-chic-trench-skirt-set.before: One size. Buy it understanding that it is two garments rather than an outfit — the value is in how often they go out separately. Opaque tights from November, bare legs until then. Black or beige: the beige is the one that looks like a trench and the black is the one that looks like tailoring. Keep anything worn with either half plain; the set has enough going on. Among cute clothes sets it is the most useful split.

the-edgy-essential-utility-tie-side-vest.heading: Why we took this one
the-edgy-essential-utility-tie-side-vest.lead: The side ties are functional, and the shape changes completely depending on how you set them. Over a white tee and jeans it turns the plainest outfit you own into something planned.
ways: Tied — pulled in at the sides, over a white tee and straight jeans.
Loose — ties left out, over a long-sleeved black top in autumn.
Layered — over a slip dress, which is the version that surprises people.
the-edgy-essential-utility-tie-side-vest.before: Sized S, to a US 4–6, and cut close — this is not one of the forgiving one-size pieces. The ties change the silhouette completely: pulled in it is fitted, left loose it is boxy, and they are genuinely two different garments, so try both before you decide what you bought. Among aesthetic cute clothes it is the piece that does the most for a plain tee and jeans.

the-effortless-chic-wide-leg-denim.heading: Why we took this one
the-effortless-chic-wide-leg-denim.lead: An elasticated back on a jean sounds like a compromise until you have worn them on a long flight. From the outside they are simply a good pair of jeans.
ways: Day — a crisp white tee and trainers.
Evening — a knit and a heel.
Shoes — a boot or a loafer rather than a sandal; the hem sits on the ankle.
the-effortless-chic-wide-leg-denim.before: One size, with the stretch doing the sizing and the soft denim keeping the wide leg from standing away from you. The inseam is cut short on purpose — they finish at the ankle rather than the floor, which is the right proportion on a shorter frame and reads as deliberate on a taller one. Nothing oversized on top. Of all the korean fashion jeans here these are the pair most likely to be worn on a long flight.

the-essential-knit-jacket-classic-tailor.heading: Why we took this one
the-essential-knit-jacket-classic-tailor.lead: The contrast stitching is what turns a plain knit into something that looks made. It has the authority of a blazer and none of the bulk, which is the whole brief for smart-casual.
ways: Casual — denim and a tee underneath.
Work — trousers and a polo neck.
Open — where it reads as a cardigan with opinions rather than a jacket.

Buttoned it reads as tailoring; open it reads as knitwear — and the contrast stitching is what keeps the open version from looking unfinished. Treat it as a knit rather than a jacket: cold wash, dried flat, folded rather than hung. Three colours, and the navy is the one that goes to work most. A korean fashion jacket that solves the sleeve problem a structured blazer creates for petite clothes for work.

the-essential-modern-bomber-elevate-your.heading: Why we took this one
the-essential-modern-bomber-elevate-your.lead: Light enough to carry and enough to cut a morning wind. Over wide denim it is street style; over a dress it is better, because the sportiness against something fluid is what makes the outfit.
ways: Straightforward — wide-leg denim and trainers.
Better — over a midi dress, where the sportiness against something fluid makes the outfit.
Winter — under a heavier coat, which the light shell allows.

The full zip means it can be worn open without losing its shape, which a half-zip cannot. Among casual korean fashion pieces it is the one that gets grabbed on the way out.

the-executive-plaid-long-vest.heading: Why we took this one
the-executive-plaid-long-vest.lead: There are no sleeves to shorten, which solves the blazer problem for anyone it usually swamps. The fringed edges and ribbon-trimmed pockets are where the money went.

Weekend — over a polo neck and jeans.
Summer — on its own over a cami, where it does a jacket's job without a jacket's heat.

For petite clothes for work it adds a layer without adding a sleeve.

the-executive-pleat-trench-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-executive-pleat-trench-dress.lead: A double-breasted blazer joined to a knife-pleated skirt, and the join is the whole idea. Buttoned it is a dress; open over a knit and trousers it is a trench.
the-executive-pleat-trench-dress.wear: A court shoe and a plain bag. A polo neck underneath and trousers if you are wearing it open. Nothing patterned — the pleats and the lapels are already two ideas.
ways: Closed — a court shoe and a plain bag, which is the office version.
Open — over a polo neck and trousers, as a long jacket.
Winter — belted, with opaque tights and a wool coat.

Lapels want an empty neckline — no scarf, no necklace. Nothing patterned anywhere near it: the pleats and the lapels are already two ideas and a third flattens all of them. A korean fashion formal dress that reads as tailoring rather than as an occasion, which is why it gets worn weekly.

the-faux-layered-ribbed-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
the-faux-layered-ribbed-cardigan.lead: Three tortoiseshell buttons against mint is the contrast the whole piece hangs on. It is the thing people put a hand on before they have read the label.
ways: Plain — a white tee and straight jeans.
Tonal — cream trousers, for the version in one colour family.
Layered — over a dress, with the mock layer showing at the hem.

Mohair sheds for the first few wears — wear it over something you do not mind picking fluff off, and give it a shake rather than a brush. Nothing else coloured: the seafoam is doing the work and a second colour flattens it. The faux-layered hem means it looks like two garments while packing as one, which is most of why this piece of aesthetic cute clothes travels.

the-garden-fresh-knit-vest-a-taste-of-ru.heading: Why we took this one
the-garden-fresh-knit-vest-a-taste-of-ru.lead: Tomatoes on the vine, stitched not printed, with the word embroidered above them. It is silly in the way good knitwear is sometimes silly, and it is the piece people photograph.
ways: Obvious — a crisp white shirt underneath with the collar out, which is still the best.
Everyday — a long-sleeved tee, for the school run.
Unexpected — over a shirt dress, which is the version that surprises people.

Keep everything else plain; one piece of whimsy per outfit is the rule and this uses it up. Grey or ivory: the ivory makes the embroidery louder. Among cute clothes to wear it is the one that makes people smile.

the-heirloom-bloom-knit-vest.heading: Why we took this one
the-heirloom-bloom-knit-vest.lead: The embroidery follows the button placket rather than sitting in a block, which is why it reads as inherited rather than bought. The lilac does more against camel than it sounds like it will.
ways: Winter — over a polo neck, with straight trousers.
Spring — over a white shirt, with the collar out.
Skirt — over a shirt and a midi, which is the longest line it makes.
the-heirloom-bloom-knit-vest.before: One size. Keep whatever is underneath plain. Grey or lilac: the grey is the one that goes to work. For cute clothes for women in their 30s it is the piece that does decoration without doing costume.

the-heritage-corduroy-overshirt-effortle.heading: Why we took this one
the-heritage-corduroy-overshirt-effortle.lead: Longer than a shirt, which is what lets it work as a light jacket. Two colours that are both easier to wear than a navy overshirt, and softer than one too.

Buttoned — over a tee with the sleeves rolled, when it warms up.
Open — over denim, trousers or leggings, as a light jacket.

It is a three-season korean fashion jacket rather than a coat: right for October, a layer in January. Among cute fall fashion pieces it is the one with the most texture for the least effort.

the-heritage-corduroy-wide-leg-trouser.heading: Why we took this one
the-heritage-corduroy-wide-leg-trouser.lead: Wide-wale cord with real weight to it: the ribs throw a shadow, which is why a plain trouser in this fabric reads as anything but plain. The warmest trousers we sell.
ways: Balanced — a fine knit tucked in, which keeps the proportion.
Never — anything bulky on top, or the whole outfit becomes volume.
Shoes — a boot with some height under them, always.

They need a shoe with height; a flat under a wide cord leg leaves nothing at the hem. The warmest korean fashion pants here.

the-highland-wanderer-plaid-maxi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-highland-wanderer-plaid-maxi-skirt.lead: The most colourful skirt in the shop and still a neutral once a white shirt is above it. Two gathered tiers, which is where the swing comes from.
ways: Photographed — a white shirt and boots, which is the right version.
Winter — a plain black knit and a tall boot.
Never — anything else patterned, or anything voluminous above it.
