Among cute fall fashion pieces it is the korean fashion skirt that people photograph and then wear every weekend until March.

the-hooded-flannel-overshirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-hooded-flannel-overshirt.lead: A jersey hood sewn into a flannel collar: not quite a shirt, not quite a jacket, which is the whole appeal. It gets left on the back of a chair and worn again tomorrow.
ways: Easiest — over a white tee and jeans, which is the simplest outfit in the shop.
Deep winter — over a hoodie, with the hood out.
Plain — over anything unpatterned; the check will not share.

A korean fashion jacket for October and a mid-layer in January, and the cheapest way to make jeans and a tee look deliberate.

the-knitted-fringe-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-knitted-fringe-midi-skirt.lead: The fringe is what takes it out of the basics drawer, and the three colours are the ones people actually reach for. It quietly becomes the most-worn thing you own.
ways: Autumn — a chunky knit and boots.
Summer — a fitted tee and flat sandals.
Any season — with black, cream or denim, which all three colours take.

The fringe is knitted in rather than sewn on, so it will not shed, but it will tangle in a machine — wash it cold in a mesh bag and dry it flat. Three colours, and people genuinely buy a second one, which is the most honest thing we can say about a korean fashion skirt. Keep the top half fitted.

the-midnight-muse-wide-leg-denim.heading: Why we took this one
the-midnight-muse-wide-leg-denim.lead: The darkest denim we stock, with almost no fading in it. Dark jeans take a heel and a blazer as easily as trainers, which is the argument for owning one pair this colour.
the-midnight-muse-wide-leg-denim.wear: A knit tucked in and a heel; a blazer over the top if it is going somewhere with a dress code. Dark denim takes tailoring as easily as trainers, which is the argument for owning one pair this colour.
ways: Smart — a knit tucked in and a heel.
Dress code — a blazer over the top, which dark denim allows and pale denim does not.
Easy — trainers and a sweatshirt, which is the same trousers doing nothing special.
the-midnight-muse-wide-leg-denim.before: Sized L, cut to a 29–30 inch waist. Dark denim takes tailoring as easily as trainers, which is the whole argument for owning one pair this colour — and the reason these turn up under petite clothes for work as often as under weekend searches. Wash them inside out and cold for the first few washes; indigo this deep gives up colour early. The leg is wide, so keep the top half close.

the-modern-maven-tailored-trousers.heading: Why we took this one
the-modern-maven-tailored-trousers.lead: Cut to end above the shoe, so a shorter leg reads as the design rather than as an alteration you never made. Camel, which does more for a wardrobe than another black trouser.
ways: Work — a fine knit tucked in and a loafer.
Colour — white, black, navy or anything jewel-toned above them; camel takes all four.
Coat — a longer one rather than a cropped one, to keep the line going.
the-modern-maven-tailored-trousers.before: Sized M, cut to a 27–28 inch waist, with real stretch in the cloth so they sit through a day at a desk without seating out at the knee. Camel shows a mark, so these are not the pair for a train seat and a coffee. For petite dress pants for work the stretch is what makes them wearable straight from the box rather than after a hem. Press on the reverse if you want the crease sharp.

the-rib-knit-luxe-loungewear-set.heading: Why we took this one
the-rib-knit-luxe-loungewear-set.lead: Wide-leg trousers that drape are the difference between a lounge set and a tracksuit. The hoodie on its own goes with jeans, which is how most of it gets worn.
ways: Together — with trainers, for a day of errands.
Hoodie alone — with straight jeans, which is how most of it gets worn.
Trousers alone — with a fitted knit tucked in and a loafer.
the-rib-knit-luxe-loungewear-set.before: One size, in a rib that holds its shape rather than growing through the day. The mocha is the one that reads least like loungewear and gets out of the house most; the black is the one that gets worn at home. Buy it knowing the hoodie will do more work than the set. Wash cold and dry flat — a hot drum takes the spring out of a rib permanently. The softest of our cute clothes sets.

the-ribbed-full-zip-knit-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
the-ribbed-full-zip-knit-cardigan.lead: Built like a sweatshirt and knitted like a cardigan, which is the combination most people actually want in October. The rib holds its shape through a day.
ways: Everyday — jeans, a crossbody bag and trainers; the cardigan is what makes that look assembled.
Winter — zipped to the collar under a coat.
Spring — open over a tee, as a light jacket.
the-ribbed-full-zip-knit-cardigan.before: One size, in a rib that holds its shape rather than growing through the day. A full zip is the detail that earns the price: zipped to the collar it is a jumper, half-zipped it is a cardigan, open it is a jacket, and no pullover does all three. Black or oatmeal; the oatmeal shows more and gets worn more. Cold wash, dried flat, folded rather than hung. The most useful korean fashion winter layer here.

the-sailor-collar-midi-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-sailor-collar-midi-dress.lead: The collar is the point and the rest of the dress is deliberately quiet so it has room. It goes to a christening and then to the pub, which is more than most dresses manage.
ways: Weekday — flat boots and bare legs.
Anything else — a heel and a long coat.
Neckline — empty; the collar is already doing it.
the-sailor-collar-midi-dress.before: Sized M, to a US 8–10, with the hem below the knee. The collar is the design and it wants nothing near it — no necklace, no scarf, and a plain bag rather than a patterned one. On a shorter frame the midi length sits at mid-calf, which suits this shape better than the knee would. Among petite dresses casual options it is the one that looks like an outfit while taking no thought at all.

the-satin-crest-luxury-blouse.heading: Why we took this one
the-satin-crest-luxury-blouse.lead: Loose satin sits better on most people than a fitted shirt, and it presses flat without a fight. Tucked in it is the dressy half of an outfit; left out it is simply considered.
ways: Tucked — into pressed trousers, as the dressy half of an outfit.
Untucked — over jeans, where it reads considered rather than casual.
Jewellery — a flat gold earring and nothing at the neck.
the-satin-crest-luxury-blouse.before: Sized M–L, to a US 8–14. Satin shows every iron mark and every pull, so hang it, press it on the reverse through a cloth, and keep it away from a rough bag strap. The crest at the neck is the only ornament — a necklace near it is one thing too many. For petite clothes for work it is the piece that makes plain black trousers look like a decision rather than a default.

the-sunset-luxe-knit-jogger.heading: Why we took this one
the-sunset-luxe-knit-jogger.lead: A cashmere blend soft enough that the first thing anyone does is put a hand on them. Deep pockets that are real, and a tangerine that is far easier to wear than it looks.
ways: Home — a fitted knit and a trainer.
Out — a long coat and a loafer, which is what makes them read as trousers.
Colour — the tangerine with cream or grey, which is easier than it sounds.
the-sunset-luxe-knit-jogger.before: One size, with the drawstring doing the sizing and a cashmere blend doing the softness — which means treating them as knitwear: cold wash, dried flat, folded rather than hung. The tangerine is the loudest thing on the rail and the one that surprises people by working. Keep the top half fitted; a cuffed leg and a loose jumper is a lot of shape. The most comfortable korean fashion pants here.

the-tailored-traveler-trousers.heading: Why we took this one
the-tailored-traveler-trousers.lead: Olive behaves like a neutral and is not black, which is most of the appeal. They come out of a suitcase with nothing to answer for and will do a week away on their own.
ways: Smart — a white shirt and loafers.
Winter — a black polo neck and boots.
Colour — a bright knit, which the olive takes better than any other trouser here.
the-tailored-traveler-trousers.before: Sized M, cut to a 27–28 inch waist, straight through the leg and finishing at the ankle. They are here because they come out of a suitcase without a crease, which is a narrow virtue that matters enormously if you travel. Olive is the quietest way to own a coloured trouser — it behaves like navy and photographs like a decision. For petite dress pants for women the straight leg needs no hem at this inseam.

the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt.lead: Openwork that is lace without being delicate about it, and fully lined, so the crochet is texture rather than transparency. It is the skirt people pack.
ways: Summer — a white tee and flat sandals.
Autumn — a cream knit and boots.
Packed — it folds flat and does not crease, which is why it ends up in a suitcase.
the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt.before: Two sizes, cut to a 25–26 or a 27–28 inch waist. Crochet is open by nature — check the lining against the light before you wear it somewhere bright, and wear a slip under it if you would rather not think about it. Hand wash cold and dry flat; a machine will pull the open stitch out of shape. For cute clothes for vacation this is the korean fashion skirt that earns its place in the bag.

the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt-2.heading: Why we took this one
the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt-2.lead: The shimmer is worked through the yarn rather than printed on it, so it catches the light as you turn and disappears when you stand still. A mermaid line done in a knit, which moves.
ways: Evening — a fitted knit tucked in and a heel.
Daytime — a plain long-sleeved top and boots.
Never — anything loose on top; the silhouette is the whole point.
the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt-2.before: Sized M, cut to a 27–28 inch waist. The mermaid hem flares below the knee and the body is close all the way down, so this is a line rather than a shape — anything oversized above it erases the design entirely. The rib stretches but does not forgive, so measure rather than guess. Wash cold in a mesh bag and dry flat. The most deliberately shaped korean fashion skirt in the shop.

the-terracotta-architectural-pencil-skir.heading: Why we took this one
the-terracotta-architectural-pencil-skir.lead: Terracotta does more for a cream silk shirt than black ever will. The wrap panel draws a diagonal across a shape that is otherwise all vertical lines.
ways: Soft — cream silk tucked in, with a pointed flat.
Sharp — a black knit tucked in, with a low heel.
Tonal — leather in the same warm family, which terracotta takes well.
the-terracotta-architectural-pencil-skir.before: Sized M, cut to a 27–28 inch waist, with the wrap front holding the shape rather than relying on a zip. Tuck everything in — a pencil skirt with an untucked top loses the line, and the line is what you are buying. The hem sits below the knee, so the walking room comes from the wrap rather than a slit. For petite clothes for work it is the korean fashion skirt that reads most senior.

the-urban-explorer-utility-set-modern-ch.heading: Why we took this one
the-urban-explorer-utility-set-modern-ch.lead: The only set we carry with real pockets in both halves. Sporty without being sportswear, and the drawstring hem lets you set the shape of the jacket.
ways: Together — with a trainer or a flat boot.
Jacket — over a dress, which is the version that surprises people.
Skirt — under a fine knit, where the cargo pockets read as texture.
the-urban-explorer-utility-set-modern-ch.before: One size. Nothing patterned anywhere near it — this set is about shape and hardware, and a print fights both. The jacket is cut to layer over a knit and the skirt sits at the natural waist, so the two halves genuinely go out separately, which is most of the value. Among aesthetic cute clothes it is the set with the most structure and the least fuss.

the-urban-nomad-corduroy-cargo-pants.heading: Why we took this one
the-urban-nomad-corduroy-cargo-pants.lead: Harvest gold is the colour of the season every season, and it is more wearable than it reads on a screen. Cord instead of drill, so the leg falls rather than stands.
ways: Sharp — a black polo neck, fitted.
Easy — a white tee, tucked or half-tucked.
Shoes — boots rather than trainers, which the leg and the pocket volume want.
the-urban-nomad-corduroy-cargo-pants.before: One size. Something fitted on top, always — the leg is doing enough and the pockets add width at the thigh, so volume above it leaves nowhere for the eye to rest. Fine-wale corduroy flattens where it is pressed: hang them and never iron the nap directly. For cute fall fashion these are the korean fashion pants that get worn from September until the cold ones come out.

ultimate-comfort-unbeatable-style-the-co.heading: Why we took this one
ultimate-comfort-unbeatable-style-the-co.lead: A zip matters more than it sounds in a week of changing weather: open over a tee, closed on the school run. Two of the four greys are different enough to own both.
ways: Together — with trainers, which is what it was bought for.
Hoodie — with straight jeans and a long coat.
Trousers — with a fitted long-sleeved top, which the crop above wants.
ultimate-comfort-unbeatable-style-the-co.before: One size. Four colours, and two of the greys are different enough that people own both — the melange reads softer, the plain grey reads sportier. The hoodie is cropped, so it wants the set's high waist or a high-waisted jean underneath; over a low rise it will look like a mistake. Fleece picks up lint from a towel, so wash it alone. The warmest of our comfy cute clothes.

unwind-in-style-the-unavailable-tiered-s.heading: Why we took this one
unwind-in-style-the-unavailable-tiered-s.lead: UNAVAILABLE, PRIVATE REASONS, across the chest — a joke worn at a distance, which is the best kind. The tiers give it a shape so it does not simply hang.
ways: School run — leggings and trainers.
Properly out — boots and a long coat.
Never — anything fitted over it; the tiers are the shape.
unwind-in-style-the-unavailable-tiered-s.before: Sized XL, to a US 16–18, and cut loose on top of that — this is a dress with room in it rather than a dress that skims. The tiers add volume from the hip down, which is why nothing structured belongs over the top. Black or oatmeal; the oatmeal shows a mark and the black does not. Among comfy cute clothes it is the one you reach for on a day with no plan and no patience.

urban-glen-plaid-trench-coat.heading: Why we took this one
urban-glen-plaid-trench-coat.lead: A thread of pink through a black and white glen plaid, which lifts the pattern without turning it into a colour. The only full-length coat we have at the moment.
ways: Casual — over jeans and a knit, where it makes the outfit.
Smart — over tailoring, where it finishes it.
Accessories — a plain scarf or none, and nothing patterned underneath.
urban-glen-plaid-trench-coat.before: Sized L, to a US 12–14, and cut with room for a knit beneath. A trench is a three-season coat rather than a January one — it will want a jumper under it at ten degrees and will not be enough at zero. The plaid is the event, so everything underneath stays plain. Dry clean it. Of our korean fashion winter coat options this is the one that reads most like outerwear and least like a padded shell.

urban-minimalist-high-waisted-wide-leg-p.heading: Why we took this one
urban-minimalist-high-waisted-wide-leg-p.lead: Cropped on purpose, because a wide leg that reaches the floor reads as heavy. Fleece inside, so they are considerably warmer than they look.
ways: Sharp — a black knit tucked in.
Tonal — a cream one, for the version in one colour.
Shoes — a boot or a loafer rather than a trainer, and a sock worth seeing.
urban-minimalist-high-waisted-wide-leg-p.before: Two sizes, cut to a 27–28 or a 29–30 inch waist, high-rise and fleece-lined — considerably warmer than they look and too warm for an overheated office. The leg is cropped, which is deliberate: it shows the ankle, and with it the shoe and the sock, so both have to be ones you meant. As cute clothes for winter go these are the korean fashion pants that replace thermals outright.

varsity-sweat-set.heading: Why we took this one
varsity-sweat-set.lead: Sets are easy to sell and hard to buy well, because the two halves usually only work together. The crop ends at the waist here, so the sweatshirt goes with jeans and the joggers go with anything.
ways: Together — with trainers, which is the version everyone buys it for.
Top only — the cropped sweatshirt with straight jeans and a long coat.
Trousers only — with a fitted knit tucked in and a loafer.
varsity-sweat-set.before: One size. Top: chest 42–50 inches, length 17 inches. Trousers: waist 21–34 inches, rise 16 inches. The crop is cut to meet a high waist, which is what keeps the proportion right — over a low-rise trouser it will look like a mistake. Among cute clothes sets this is the one that gets worn apart as often as together, so think of it as three outfits rather than one. The sage sells first; the navy lasts longest.

velvet-whisper-wide-leg-corduroy.heading: Why we took this one
velvet-whisper-wide-leg-corduroy.lead: The warmest trousers in the shop and the reason they sell out before January. Two colours worth the name — emerald and merlot — and both go with cream and camel.
ways: Balanced — a fitted knit on top, which keeps the proportion.
Shoes — a boot, because the hem is cut short.
Neutral — everything else; the colour is the event.
velvet-whisper-wide-leg-corduroy.before: One size, with the wide leg cut from the hip and a fleece lining inside — these are properly warm, which is the point of them. Two colours and both are saturated: forest emerald and rich merlot are jewel tones rather than neutrals, so the rest of the outfit stays plain. Hang them and never iron the nap. The warmest cute clothes for cold weather on the rail, and the most colourful korean fashion pants here.

verdant-vista-pleated-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
verdant-vista-pleated-midi-skirt.lead: The lace at the hem is the only ornament, and without it this would be another winter midi. The waistband runs from 24 inches to 36, which is why it is sold as one size.
ways: Usual — boots and a denim jacket, which the lace stops from reading as plain.
Smarter — a fine knit tucked in and a low heel.
Winter — opaque tights and a long coat, with the lace showing below the hem.
verdant-vista-pleated-midi-skirt.before: One size, A-line, with the lace worked into the hem rather than added as a trim — which is why it survives a wash and why it changes the skirt from plain to considered. Cold wash in a mesh bag and dry flat; a drum will pull the lace. Noble noir or humble brown. For cute fall fashion it is the korean fashion skirt that works with a denim jacket, which most midi skirts do not.

vintage-charm-corduroy-pinafore-dress.heading: Why we took this one
vintage-charm-corduroy-pinafore-dress.lead: Nothing on the shoulders, which means the blouse or the knit underneath is half the outfit and you can change it daily. The cord is fine enough for the skirt to gather properly.
ways: October — a high-neck blouse underneath.
January — a thin knit, tights and a flat boot.
Any other time — a long-sleeved tee and boots.
vintage-charm-corduroy-pinafore-dress.before: Sized M, to a US 8–10, and cut to layer — the armholes and neckline are shaped for something underneath, which means it is three or four outfits rather than one. Corduroy has no stretch, so measure before you order. Hang it and never press the nap directly. Among korean fashion casual dress options the pinafore is the shape that solves winter, because the layer under it is yours to choose.

washed-denim-jeans.heading: Why we took this one
washed-denim-jeans.lead: The fading is done properly — at the hip and the knee, where a pair you had owned for years would fade. Mid-blue and straight, which dates slower than anything else in denim.
ways: Smart — a white shirt and loafers.
Winter — a knit and boots.
Anything — no particular shoe required, which is the point of a straight leg.
washed-denim-jeans.before: Sized by waist measurement rather than alpha, so order to the number you actually measure rather than the one you remember. A mid-blue wash is the most useful denim there is: it takes a shirt, a knit, a blazer or a sweatshirt without arguing. Wash inside out and cold to hold the wash. Among casual korean fashion staples these are the korean fashion jeans to own before any of the interesting pairs.

whimsical-corduroy-a-line-skirt-a-blosso.heading: Why we took this one
whimsical-corduroy-a-line-skirt-a-blosso.lead: The flowers are stitched, so they sit proud of the cord and catch the light. A white tee and trainers is enough; the skirt is the outfit.
ways: Enough — a white tee and trainers; the skirt is the outfit.
Winter — a plain knit and a boot.
Never — anything else patterned; the flowers are the whole idea.
whimsical-corduroy-a-line-skirt-a-blosso.before: One size, A-line, in a fine corduroy with the flowers embroidered rather than printed — so they survive a wash, but wash it cold and dry it flat because the stitching and the cord move differently in a machine. Sky-like blue or warm rich brown; the brown is the one that goes to work. For aesthetic cute clothes it is the korean fashion skirt that does the most talking for the least money.

whimsical-wonder-vest.heading: Why we took this one
whimsical-wonder-vest.lead: Small embroidered scenes you only notice from a seat away, which is exactly why they work. The cardigan underneath is deliberately plain so nothing competes with them.
ways: Plain — over a tee and jeans, which does the whole job.
Smarter — over a shirt with the collar out.
Surprising — the green, which is the colour people do not expect to like.
whimsical-wonder-vest.before: One size. Four colours, and the green is the one that gets bought after the beige was the plan. The embroidery is knitted and stitched into the piece rather than applied on top, so there is nothing to peel — but cold wash and dry flat regardless. Keep everything else plain; one decorated garment per outfit. Among cute clothes inspo pieces it is the one that turns a plain uniform into something with a point of view.

whisper-soft-faux-fur-vest.heading: Why we took this one
whisper-soft-faux-fur-vest.lead: A finer pile than the plush one — closer to shearling, and it sits flatter over whatever is underneath. The piece that makes a plain outfit look assembled.
ways: Day — over a long-sleeved knit and jeans.
Evening — over something sleeveless, as the only outer layer.
Sleeves — slim underneath, always; volume on volume is a lot.
whisper-soft-faux-fur-vest.before: Sized M, to a US 8–10, and because it is open and sleeveless the fit is forgiving — what goes underneath decides the shape. It gives a coat's warmth across the body without the bulk at the arm, which is the whole argument for a fur vest. Shake it out rather than brushing it, and never put it in a drum. For korean style winter wear it is the piece that makes a thin knit enough.

wide-leg-knit-trousers.heading: Why we took this one
wide-leg-knit-trousers.lead: The pair most people buy first and the one we reorder most. They move like loungewear and photograph like trousers, and the four colours cover most wardrobes.
wide-leg-knit-trousers.wear: A fitted knit and boots is the version that goes out; a long tee and bare feet is the version that does not. The cream is the one that looks most expensive and shows the most; the black is the one that gets worn weekly.
ways: Out — a fitted knit and boots, which is the version that leaves the house.
In — a long tee and bare feet, which is the version that does not.
Tonal — the oatmeal with cream on top, for the whole outfit in one colour.
wide-leg-knit-trousers.before: One size, with the drawstring doing the work, and the leg is wide from the hip rather than from the knee so there is no point where the fabric clings. The cream is the one that looks most expensive and shows the most; the black is the one that gets worn weekly. These are the korean fashion pants most people buy first — and the pair most often bought in a second colour a month later.

wool-blend-long-coat.heading: Why we took this one
wool-blend-long-coat.lead: No collar and no belt, which is harder to cut well than it sounds — there is nothing to hide behind. A long coat is the piece a Korean winter wardrobe is built around.
ways: Casual — jeans and trainers.
Smart — a midi skirt and boots.
Evening — over a dress, which a long line flatters and a cropped coat does not.
wool-blend-long-coat.before: Alpha sizing, cut long and with room for a knit underneath. Cream asks for care — it marks, it shows a bag strap, and it needs a dry clean rather than a wash — but it does more for a winter wardrobe than navy ever will, because it lifts everything under it. Hang it on a broad hanger; a thin one will dent the shoulders. The most considered korean fashion winter coat we carry.

zip-through-hoodie.heading: Why we took this one
zip-through-hoodie.lead: A metal zip and pockets that take hands, which sounds like nothing until you own one without them. It goes with denim, leggings and a mini skirt and makes none of them look accidental.
ways: Denim — straight jeans and trainers.
Leggings — for the gym version, over a tee.
Mini skirt — which it goes with and does not make look accidental.
zip-through-hoodie.before: Sized S–M, to a US 4–10, cut close enough to layer under a coat in winter. Three colours, and the red is the one that gets stopped in the street. A full zip is the detail that matters here — it goes on over a done face and comes off without a struggle, which a pullover does not. Wash it inside out and cold; the red will bleed in a hot wash. The plainest of our comfy cute clothes and the most used.
